chapters.headline: How to play
chapters.text: Get four of your marks in a straight line to win.

chapters.headline: Take turns
chapters.text: X goes first, then O. The frame around the board shows whose turn it is.

chapters.headline: Place a mark
chapters.text: Tap an empty cell to put your mark there.

chapters.headline: Take it back
chapters.text: Tap your last mark again to take it back. A game against the computer has no undo.

chapters.headline: Turn the tower
chapters.text: Drag around the tower to turn it. View, under More, shows a flat board.

chapters.headline: Rows
chapters.text: Four across a layer wins: 16 rows.

chapters.headline: Columns
chapters.text: Four front to back in a layer: 16 more.

chapters.headline: Pillars
chapters.text: Four straight up through the layers: the 3D twist.

chapters.headline: Flat diagonals
chapters.text: Corner to corner inside one layer: 8 lines.

chapters.headline: Rising diagonals
chapters.text: Diagonals that climb through the layers: 16 lines.

chapters.headline: Corner to corner
chapters.text: Through the middle of the cube: 4 lines.

chapters.headline: Block it
chapters.text: Three of theirs in a line? Put your mark on the fourth cell.

chapters.headline: A draw
chapters.text: A full cube with no line of four is a draw.

chapters.headline: More to find
chapters.text: Hover or long-press an icon to see what it does. The speaker arrow opens sound sets. More holds the view and play by voice.
